title: Notice of Monthly Board Meeting
paragraphs: The board meeting will convene on Wednesday at 3:00 in the afternoon in Conference Room A. All board members should arrive ten minutes early so the chairperson can begin on time.
A quorum of at least six members is required before any motion can be discussed. If we do not reach a quorum, the meeting will be postponed to the following week.
The main item this month is a vote on the new budget resolution. The chairperson will read the minute of the previous meeting first, then open the floor for comment.
The meeting is expected to adjourn by 5:00 in the afternoon. Please bring your notes and any question you would like to raise.
